text: Feature gates (feature flags) toggle product behavior in real time without deploying new code
quote: Feature Gates, commonly known as feature flags, allow you to toggle the behavior of your product in real time without deploying new code.

text: Gates can act as an emergency kill switch that immediately turns off a code branch for production users
quote: Have an emergency disable switch that lets you immediately turn off a particular code branch for users in production

text: A feature gate can be set up as a scheduled rollout that deploys a feature gradually over time
quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.

text: Runs A/B and A/B/n experiments that split users into control and test groups and report metric lifts with confidence intervals
quote: Statsig splits users into a control group and one or more test groups, serves each group a different variant, and reports metric lifts with confidence intervals.

text: Experiment scorecards capture a hypothesis plus primary and secondary metrics, and are required to create an experiment
quote: The Scorecard feature makes this easy by letting you enter your hypothesis and select both primary and secondary metrics.

text: Autotune multi-armed bandit shifts traffic toward high-performing variants and can identify a winner
quote: Autotune, the Multi-Armed Bandit solution, allocates traffic toward high-performing variants and can eventually identify a winning variant.

text: Evaluation is deterministic, returning the same result for the same user and config across client and server platforms
quote: Evaluation in Statsig is deterministic. Given the same user object and the same state of the experiment or feature gate, Statsig always returns the same result, even across different platforms (client or server).

text: On-device eval client SDKs keep gate and experiment definitions in memory for faster evaluation when user objects change often
quote: Statsig's client-side On-Device Eval SDKs provide an alternate client-side architecture. The device keeps the definition of each experiment or gate in memory, which allows faster evaluation when the user object changes frequently.

text: After initialization, client and server SDKs evaluate gates and experiments without a network request, typically in under 1ms
quote: After initialization, both Client and Server SDKs evaluate experiments/gates _without a network request_, and typically in less than 1ms.

text: Official CLI manages feature gates, experiments, and dynamic configs
quote: The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.

text: CLI can create, update, and delete configs in scripts and CI/CD pipelines
quote: Create, update, and delete configs through commands, run them in scripts, or integrate Statsig configuration into CI/CD pipelines.

text: HTTP API retrieves gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logs events without an SDK
quote: Overview of the Statsig HTTP API for retrieving feature gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logging events directly without an SDK.

text: Console API is a CRUD API for performing any action available in the web console without using the UI
quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.

text: Gate check endpoint evaluates gates for a user and automatically logs exposure events
quote: Evaluates one or more feature gates for a user and returns pass/fail results. Automatically logs exposure events for analytics.

text: Console API publishes a versioned, maintained OpenAPI 3.0 spec
quote: api.statsig.com publishes the Console API's machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the versioned path /openapi/20240601.json ("The \"Console API\" is the CRUD API for performing the actions offered on console.statsig.com without needing

text: API reference has an in-page Try it control that sends live requests to each endpoint
quote: The Console API reference renders an in-page live request runner per endpoint: the List Gates page ("Reference for the GET /console/v1/gates API endpoint.") carries a "Try it" control whose dialog is described in the page bundle as "Send a

text: Console API is versioned, with a guarantee that each version won't break existing usage, selected via a request header
quote: The Console API is explicitly versioned with a stability guarantee: "Statsig versions the Console API. Statsig guarantees that each version won't break existing usage; each new version introduces breaking changes. There is only one version:

text: Separate development, staging, and production environments use environment-specific SDK keys and rules
quote: Statsig documents environment-tier isolation: SDKs "evaluate feature gates, dynamic configs, and experiments differently in non-production environments like development or staging", with environment-specific SDK keys determining which rule

text: Supports SSO for authentication and SCIM for automatic user account and permission provisioning
quote: SSO handles authentication, allowing users to log in once to access multiple applications. SCIM ensures consistent management of user accounts and permissions across those applications.

text: New users with the same email domain can be added to a project automatically
quote: Basic settings include automatically adding new users with the same email domain to your project.

text: Users can invite collaborators to work on project gates and configs
quote: You can also invite others to collaborate on your Statsig projects so they can interact with your gates and configs.

text: Official MCP server lets AI tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code explore experiments and access Statsig data
quote: The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.

text: Docs MCP server lets AI clients read public Statsig documentation, with no API key required
quote: Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.

text: Users can talk to their Statsig projects from within ChatGPT
quote: Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.

text: Admins can configure Claude's connection to Statsig centrally instead of having each member authenticate
quote: Admins can configure Claude's connection to Statsig centrally instead of asking each member to authenticate.

text: Warehouse Native runs experiment analysis directly in your own data warehouse with no ETL
quote: Statsig Warehouse Native is an experimentation platform that runs analysis directly in your data warehouse.

text: Warehouse Native connects to existing datasets and any source of experiment assignment data
quote: Statsig Warehouse Native connects to your existing datasets and any source of experiment assignment data, including Statsig's SDKs and real-time logging infrastructure.

text: Stats engine can analyze existing experiments run in third-party or internal systems
quote: Modern statistical engine for running analyses on existing experiments from third-party or internal systems.

text: Experiment measurement tools include CUPED, stratified sampling, and switchback tests
quote: Statsig offers a full suite of experiment measurement tools, including CUPED, Stratified Sampling, Switchback Tests, and more.

text: Power analysis estimates the traffic and duration an experiment needs
quote: A power analysis tells you how much traffic and how many days it needs, which is the target duration you set during setup.

text: Free tier includes feature flags and 2 million metered events
quote: You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.

text: Infra analytics ingests OpenTelemetry metrics and traces, searches and groups logs, and alerts on regressions
quote: Infra Analytics: Monitor and debug service health alongside product outcomes. Ingest metrics and traces with OpenTelemetry, search and group logs, and set alerts to catch regressions.

text: Product analytics shows trends in core business metrics and user behavior
quote: Product Analytics: Understand the trends of your core business metrics, user behavior, and more.

text: Console shows feature gate exposures so you can monitor who encounters a gate
quote: After your Feature Gate is live, view Feature Gate exposures in the Statsig console to monitor who encounters your gate.

text: Gates can target users by context such as device, browser type, version, and other environment attributes
quote: Change app behavior based on context like device, browser type, version, and other environment attributes

text: Feature gate overrides let specific users bypass the gate
quote: set up Feature Gate overrides to allow specific users to bypass the gate.

text: Experiments support layered targeting rules and overrides that force specific users into a variant for QA
quote: You can also layer multiple targeting rules and set overrides to force specific users into a variant for testing or QA.

text: Layers let you manage multiple experiments and feature flags together
quote: A Layer allows you to manage multiple experiments and feature flags together.

text: Persistent assignment keeps a user's variant stable during an experiment despite allocation or targeting changes
quote: Persistent assignment ensures that a user's variant stays consistent while an experiment is running, regardless of changes to allocation or targeting.

text: Target apps scope gates, experiments, and dynamic configs to specific applications within one project
quote: Use target apps in Statsig SDKs to scope feature gates, experiments, and dynamic configs to specific applications inside a single project.

text: Linking only client-specific configs to a client key's target app keeps other configs from being visible
quote: Specifying a target app for your client key and linking only client-specific configs to it keeps those configs from being visible.

text: Logs custom events for analytics and metric calculation used to measure experiment outcomes
quote: Logs one or more custom events for analytics and metric calculation. Events are used to measure experiment outcomes and user behavior.

text: SDKs handle caching, retry mechanisms, and networking for you
quote: Abstract the complexity: Statsig handles caching, retry mechanisms, and networking.

text: Server and client SDKs can be deployed together to gate features on both the client and server side
quote: Many customers deploy both Server and Client SDKs, which lets them gate features on both the client and server side.

text: SDK caches previous evaluations locally so they are available in the next session if the network call fails
quote: The SDK caches previous evaluations locally so they're available in the next session if there is no successful network call.

text: Custom storage adapters (local or remote) enable persistence of assignments across multiple devices
quote: You can implement an adapter that uses Local Storage, or one that uses remote storage, to enable persistence across multiple devices.

text: Daily deduplicated first-exposure rollups are computed and exported to your warehouse
quote: Statsig calculates deduplicated first-exposure rollups for you on a daily basis and exports that miniaturized dataset to your warehouse.

text: OpenAI integration logs AI requests, captures metrics, and runs experiments on prompts, models, and parameters
quote: Integrate Statsig with OpenAI to log AI requests, capture metrics, and run experiments on prompts, models, and parameters across your applications.

text: AI Configs are fetched at runtime so prompts or models can change without deploying code
quote: Your app fetches the AI Config at runtime, so you can change a prompt or model without deploying code.

text: Prompts can be versioned, with a chosen live version retrieved in production via server SDKs
quote: You can version prompts, choose which version is live in Statsig, and retrieve prompts in production using the Statsig server SDKs.

text: Offline evals automatically grade model outputs on a fixed test set to catch regressions before release
quote: Offline evals provide quick, automated grading of model outputs on a fixed test set. They catch wins and regressions before you expose changes to any real users.

text: Runs up to 10 prompts side by side on the same inputs
quote: Runs up to 10 prompts side by side on the same inputs.

text: Stats engine provides real-time insight into AI model performance metrics such as cost, accuracy, and latency
quote: Using Statsig's stats engine, you gain real-time insights into model performance across metrics such as cost, accuracy, and latency.
